Aquarius Baseball - Genkai no, Sono Saki.name: Aquarius Baseball: Genkai no, Sono Saki e.
Aquarius Baseball - Genkai no, Sono Saki.summary: A promotional game for Coca Cola's Aquarius line of sports drinks. Released exclusively in Japan and given to contest winners.

Billy's Boot Camp - Wii de Enjoy Diet!.name: Billy's Boot Camp: Wii de Enjoy Diet!
Billy's Boot Camp - Wii de Enjoy Diet!.summary: Billy's Boot Camp: Wii de Enjoy Diet! (ビリーズブートキャンプ Wiiでエンジョイダイエット!) is a fitness game based on the military fitness method advocated by Billy Wayne Blanks in the United States. Levels and popular track inclusions allow players to experience the game's completely different but equally interesting fun! The game gives players a more efficient fitness slimming effect, displaying the current calorie consumption after each practice. Players can also collect various slimming actions in the form of "action cards".

Classic British Motor Racing.name: Classic British Motor Racing
Classic British Motor Racing.summary: Classic British Motor Racing is a racing simulation game. Choose from an amazing range of 13 high performance classic cars, including Austin Mini, Austin-Healy, MG, Rover and Triumph. Each car is accurately recreated under license and features the real handling characteristics of the vehicles. Race through six different courses throughout the British Isles, including the heart-stopping thrills of the traditional 'Westminster Run' around the streets of London. Take on various game modes, including Time Trial and Grand Prix. Try and beat the track records or race against friends in the insanely addictive multiplayer mode.

Cocoto Kart Racer 2.name: Cocoto Kart Racer 2
Cocoto Kart Racer 2.summary: Cocoto Kart Racer 2 is a Racing game, developed by Neko Entertainment and published by Bigben Interactive, which was released in Europe in 2011.

Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.name: Guitar Hero: Smash Hits
Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.summary:
Guitar Hero Smash Hits is the best of Guitar Hero music, now for the full band! Rock out to the most fun tracks from Guitar Hero, Guitar Hero II, Guitar Hero: Rock the 80's, and Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock, now for the full band. Using the controllers strum, drum, and belt out a collection of master tracks including Nirvana, Judas Priest, Slayer, Rage Against the Machine, Queen, and many more.

Titled Guitar Hero Greatest Hits in Europe and Australia.

Jerry Rice & Nitus' Dog Football.name: Jerry Rice & Nitus' Dog Football
Jerry Rice & Nitus' Dog Football.summary: Hall of Fame wide receiver, Jerry Rice and his dog Nitus hit the canine gridiron for some family-friendly, seven-on-seven action. Sports just aren’t for humans anymore! The dogs have turned pro as they compete alongside their owners for the coveted golden hydrant. 1 to 4 player season and exhibition modes, with 20 dog breeds, 14 human quarterbacks, 185 plays, and 12 Interactive Fields. It's non-stop, "Lick Your Face" and "Wag Your Tail" action for the whole family.

North American Hunting Extravaganza.name: North American Hunting Extravaganza
North American Hunting Extravaganza.summary:
Experience the Thrill of the Hunt! 
 
Head out into the wild to track and hunt the most dangerous game in North America. Set your sights on over 20 different wildlife species, with a variety of weapons and hunting equipment at your disposal.

Pikmin.name: Pikmin
Pikmin.summary: Pikmin just got a bit more perfect! Whether you are a Pikmin fan or have yet to be bewitched by its charms, NEW PLAY CONTROL! Pikmin now makes full use of the Wii Remote's point-and-select capability, which will delight anyone who enjoys a real-time strategy adventure.

Resident Evil Archives - Resident Evil Z.name: Resident Evil Archives: Resident Evil Zero
Resident Evil Archives - Resident Evil Z.summary: Resident Evil Archives: Resident Evil Zero is the port of the game Resident Evil Zero for the Wii console system.
